evidence: Modifies net_processing.cpp and introduces blockdownloadman_impl.cpp to extract block download scheduling and peer state.
rationale: Decomposes PeerManagerImpl by extracting block download scheduling and peer tracking into a standalone module with isolated unit and fuzz tests. This modularization improves the maintainability and testability of complex p2p relay logic, but it is an internal refactoring that does not fix an active bug or alter protocol behavior.
